notes.text: Hack the Doors says Peek 3, and the rulebook's Peek says 'Discard any number of them, then put the rest back in any order.' The CLI only asked me to order the 3 Good Stuff cards, with no way to discard any. Expected a discard choice. Either the CLI skips it or Peek in this build is reorder only; question for the designer.

Floor 4 turn 12: Regular Monster 4 (Oomph 8 and Scramble 12, or Oomph 20) is out of reach for this 5-card hand, and its Flee is only Exhaust 1. I am fleeing on purpose instead of paying cards for an impossible clear. Since I hold 5 cards I will draw nothing next turn, so the Flee is a pure room reroll that also keeps my hand. Question: is a cheap Flee that keeps the hand meant to be a free reroll?

Floor 5 turn 15: Ambush forced Monster 5-3 (Heavy, Oomph 15 and Scramble 15) on the first reveal, with a hand of Overdrive x2, Tag Team, Shove, Cross Punch and Gray Hit 'n Run, Duck Under, Peek, Work The Angles, Quick Vault. Best case I can count is about Oomph 12 and Scramble 8, and every play also exhausts a deck card under Heavy. I am fleeing without playing. Rulebook has Ambush forcing entry but gives no way to see that the only forced room is out of reach; just noting the first-turn wall.
